summary: Frontend-only verification of Journey card fix on StudyLocus dashboard. Logged in as admin, confirmed journey days flow HORIZONTALLY (row-first). Verified tooltips render date, Today/Exam badges, planned test names, and 'No test scheduled · click to add' for empty days. Added a test via Test Planner and confirmed the corresponding Journey cell picked up class 'day-test' and its tooltip shows the test name.

issues: graph-container uses justify-content: center, so today cell is not at the far-left of row 1 (row is centered). Horizontal sequential flow still holds; consider left-align if strict left-to-right from column 0 is desired.

critical_code_review_comments: JourneyCard sets hover state on every mousemove which triggers a re-render per pixel; consider throttling or storing position via ref/CSS transform for perf.
graph-container has align-content: start + justify-content: center; if strict left-to-right anchoring from row 0/col 0 is required, remove justify-content: center.
seed_data_creation: Added one test 'Mock JEE Test 1' for today+5 days via Test Planner during test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Journey card horizontal flow + tooltip (date + test names) verified end-to-end. 133 cells rendered from today (2026-09-11) to exam (2027-01-21). First 15 cells shared the same y coordinate with strictly increasing x (14/14 horizontal transitions). Test day showed class 'day day-test' and tooltip 'Wed Sep 16 2026 • Mock JEE Test 1'. Today tooltip: 'Fri Sep 11 2026 · Today No test scheduled · click to add'.
rca of the issue: Previous CSS used grid-template-rows: repeat(7, ...) with grid-auto-flow: column producing GitHub-style vertical (top-to-bottom then next column). Fix switched to grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, 12px) + grid-auto-flow: row, making cells flow left-to-right and wrap to next row. Tooltip already included date label and mapped test names via testsByDate.
